card.line: Cyprus is a large island in the Mediterranean Sea where Paul and Barnabas began their first mission trip, and where Barnabas later returned with Mark.

moments.title: Sent out to Cyprus
moments.text: The Holy Spirit sent Barnabas and Saul out, and they sailed from Seleucia to Cyprus. At Salamis they proclaimed the word of God in the Jewish synagogues, with John as their helper.

moments.title: The sorcerer is struck blind
moments.text: At Paphos, the proconsul Sergius Paulus wanted to hear the word of God, but the sorcerer Elymas opposed them. Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, spoke against him, and Elymas was made blind for a time. The proconsul saw this and believed.

moments.title: Barnabas returns with Mark
moments.text: Paul and Barnabas disagreed sharply about taking Mark with them. They parted company, and Barnabas took Mark and sailed for Cyprus.
